summary: Iteration 8: Cloudinary integration + Vercel compatibility testing. All 7 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend homepage and admin dashboard both load correctly. Cloudinary upload/delete for both hero and category images verified working end-to-end.
verified_working: POST /api/auth/login with hello@sojaru.co.in / admin123 returns JWT with is_admin: true
GET /api/settings returns hero, marquee_texts, festive fields
GET /api/products returns {items: [...], total, pages} - note: response is a paginated object, NOT a bare array
POST /api/admin/category-images/{slug} uploads image to Cloudinary, returns https://res.cloudinary.com/ URL
DELETE /api/admin/category-images/{slug} removes from DB and Cloudinary
POST /api/admin/hero-images uploads image to Cloudinary, returns https://res.cloudinary.com/ URL in hero_images array
DELETE /api/admin/hero-images/{id} removes from DB and Cloudinary
Homepage loads with hero, marquee, products and no JS errors
Admin /admin login form visible, login works, dashboard shows Hero Banner / Hero Text / Moving Text / Festive Collection / Category Images / Customizable Products tabs
critical_code_review_comments: category_images[slug] in public_settings response returns a plain URL string (not a dict with 'url' key). This is fine as long as frontend handles it, but inconsistent with hero_images which returns objects with {id, url, public_id}. Worth standardizing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudinary fully working. /api/products returns paginated object {items, total, pages, page} not a bare list. category_images[slug] in settings response is a plain URL string. Admin dashboard all tabs visible and working.
